title: reAlpha | Illinois and Ohio Real Estate Expansion | 2026 | reAlpha Investor Relations: Nasdaq AIRE Market Growth | reAlpha
summary: reAlpha expands its real estate brokerage footprint into Illinois and Ohio, bringing real estate and mortgage services to buyers in Chicago and Columbus.
body_markdown:
*New licenses bring reAlpha Realty to two major Midwest housing markets, extending its integrated real estate and mortgage services to more homebuyers*


**DUBLIN, Ohio, November 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)** – reAlpha Tech Corp. (Nasdaq: AIRE) (“reAlpha” or the “Company”), an AI-powered real estate technology company, today announced that its realty division is now licensed in Illinois and Ohio. This expansion grows the combined footprint of the Company’s realty division to 15 states and Washington, D.C.


The expansion advances reAlpha’s Midwest growth strategy, extending its real estate services into two significant regional markets: Columbus, the capital of Ohio, and Chicago, the Midwest's largest city, as identified by the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago. With reAlpha’s mortgage division also licensed in both states, eligible buyers can access real estate representation and mortgage services through the Company’s integrated platform. Eligible buyers may receive commission rebates of up to approximately 1.5% of the purchase price when using both services, subject to program terms and conditions and where permitted by law. In 2025, homebuyers purchasing through reAlpha’s realty division received a median rebate of approximately $10,450.


Illinois recorded 136,650 closed home sales in 2025, including approximately 89,100 in the Chicago metropolitan area, per Illinois REALTORS®. Ohio REALTORS® data shows that Ohio recorded 126,015 home sales statewide during the same period. Central Ohio, including the Columbus metropolitan area, accounted for 29,626 transactions and a record $11.1 billion in residential sales volume in 2025, according to Columbus REALTORS®.


The Company’s entry into these markets comes as the Midwest shows signs of renewed growth. The U.S. Census Bureau reported approximately 16,000 net domestic migrants to the Midwest between July 2024 and July 2025, marking the first positive net domestic migration to the region in the decade. Ohio was a significant recipient of those domestic migrants, receiving approximately 11,900 of overall net arrivals to the region. reAlpha believes the region’s relative affordability, housing demand and population trends create an opportunity to bring its buyer-focused model to more consumers.


“We’re pleased to bring realty coverage to Ohio, our home state, and to begin operations in Illinois at the same time. Chicago and Columbus are important markets with substantial housing activity, and each provides the opportunity to reach more homebuyers,” said Mike Logozzo, CEO of reAlpha. “This recent expansion increases the number of states where we offer the combination of real estate and mortgage services to local homebuyers. We're focused on bringing more of these services together and making the homebuying process more accessible through both buyer savings from the rebate and coordinated support.”


**About reAlpha Tech Corp.**


reAlpha Tech Corp. (Nasdaq: AIRE) is an AI-powered real estate technology company that aims to transform the multi-trillion-dollar U.S. real estate services market. reAlpha is developing an end-to-end platform that streamlines real estate transactions through integrated brokerage, mortgage, and title services. With a strategic, acquisition-driven growth model and proprietary AI infrastructure, reAlpha is building a vertically integrated ecosystem designed to deliver a simpler, smarter, and more affordable path to homeownership. For more information, visit[www.realpha.com](https://www.realpha.com/) .
